arguments.summary: Credential stuffing attack detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), attributed to compromised user CORP\jsmith. The attacker leveraged a Cobalt Strike beacon (detected via IDS signature ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 Activity) to execute lateral movement attempts, including failed Kerberos TGT requests (Event ID 4768) against domain controller 10.0.8.200 and SMB access to file server 10.0.5.50. Despite detection, containment actions (credential revocation, firewall block, endpoint isolation) were denied due to policy or target mismatch. The initial alert incorrectly attributed source IP as 10.0.5.14; correlation reveals true source as 10.0.5.42. No malware confirmed in sandbox analysis of related payload.

id: 5a7b8c9d-e1f2-4a3b-8c9d-0123456789ab
description: Detects Kerberos TGT requests originating from non-domain controller hosts, often indicative of credential access (e.g., Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting).
status: experimental
author: SOC Team
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1558/
logsource:
    category: authentication
    product: windows
    service: security
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 4768
        LogonType: 3
        ClientAddress|contains: '10.0.'
        NOT (
            ComputerName|endswith: 'DC01.corp.local' or
            ComputerName|endswith: 'DC02.corp.local'
        )
    condition: selection
level: high

arguments.summary: Privilege escalation incident detected on endpoint 10.0.7.33 originating from source IP 10.0.5.14. The attacker exploited a PrintNightmare variant (CVE-2025-31337) to achieve SYSTEM-level access and attempted Golden Ticket creation using the krbtgt hash. Initial access was established via a compromised finance workstation (WS-FIN-042, 10.0.5.42) exhibiting Cobalt Strike beaconing. Lateral movement occurred via SMB to internal systems. Containment actions were denied due to policy restrictions, highlighting a gap in emergency response authorization.

timeline.description: Benign document created on WS-IT-101; no malicious activity observed.
External port scan detected from unknown source to WS-IT-101; blocked by NDR.
Initial compromise: Outbound HTTPS connection from WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) to known C2 infrastructure (198.51.100.23).
Suspicious rundll32 execution detected in user temp directory on WS-FIN-042.
IDS alert triggered: Cobalt Strike beaconing confirmed from WS-FIN-042 to C2 server.
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042, indicating credential access attempt.
Lateral movement via SMB to file server (10.0.5.50) using compromised CORP\jsmith credentials.
Privilege escalation detected on WS-IT-101 (10.0.7.33) via CVE-2025-31337 exploit from 10.0.5.14.
Containment actions (krbtgt rotation, trust disablement) attempted but denied by IAM system due to insufficient authorization.
